ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: speaker
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Chairs the council's meetings and speaks for the colony. While someone holds the seat, everyone's trust in the council slowly rises.

duties.li: Everyone's trust in the council rises a little each day.
The speaker is more persuasive (social impact up 15%, negotiation up 10%).

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} plans to say a few words at the next supper, and hopes people will listen.
{PAWN_nameDef} expects to spend the first week settling arguments.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} says the council has stopped listening, and promises meetings where everyone gets a word in.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants the colony's quarrels brought to the table before they turn into feuds.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises to speak for the colony plainly, and to say no when no is the answer.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises shorter meetings that actually decide something.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: marshal
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Leads the colony's defense and runs its drills. After a fight at home, a marshal who fought in it has a word with each of those who fought alongside, which eases their strain.

duties.li: Drills and militia drills train everyone half again as fast.
Colonists aim and strike a little better (shooting accuracy up 0.5%, melee hit chance up 2%).
The marshal aims and strikes better, and is a little less likely to have a mental break.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} says the first job is to walk the wall and see where it is weak.
{PAWN_nameDef} talks about drills at dawn, and people groan.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants to know where everyone sleeps, so they can be found quickly in a raid.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} talks of the last raid, and wants the weak side of the wall seen to before the next one.
{PAWN_nameDef} says a quiet spell is when drills count, and wants everyone at them.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises a proper watch at night, with nobody sleeping through it.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: quartermaster
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Keeps the stores, counts the silver and haggles with traders.

duties.li: Dilemma answers and decrees that take goods or silver from the stores take a quarter less.
The quartermaster gets 6% better prices from traders.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} means to count everything in the stores, twice.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants a written record of what goes in and out of the stores.
{PAWN_nameDef} means to drive a hard bargain with the next trader.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} points at the empty shelves and promises meals put by before anyone goes hungry.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the stores are full enough to trade from, and means to drive a hard bargain.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises a count of the stores every week, and nothing left to rot.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: physician
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: The colony's chief doctor: tends the sick and hurt, and each day looks in on everyone who is recovering, which shortens their recovery a little.

duties.li: Everyone's wounds heal 5% faster and immunity builds 4% faster.
The physician tends wounds and operates more skillfully (tending quality up 8%, surgery success up 5%).

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} plans to wash {PAWN_possessive} hands, look over the sickbeds and make a list of what they lack.
{PAWN_nameDef} intends to ask everyone how they are sleeping, and write the answers down.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the first rule is clean hands, and the second rule is also clean hands.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} has been at the sickbeds lately, and wants a proper place for the ill and the hurt.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the medicine is running low, and wants more made or bought before it is needed.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises that nobody who is hurt will wait for a doctor.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: steward
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Looks after the colony's spirits. At a gathering the steward attends, everyone else's strain eases a little more, and while the seat is filled people's expectations rise more slowly.

duties.li: Everyone's standards rise a quarter more slowly.
The steward gets 15% more out of recreation.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} wants to know what everyone would like for the next feast.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the colony should celebrate more often, and means to see that it does.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants the common room kept warm and lit in the evenings, so people have somewhere to gather.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} says spirits are low, and promises more evenings worth staying up for.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises feasts on the days that matter, and less grumbling in between.
